course_name_en: Electrical Energy Storage and Fuel Cells

learning_outcomes.text: Students know various energy storage technologies.
They can classify them and understand the difference between power storage and energy storage.
They know the technical basics of storing and retrieving energy and the structure of storage systems.
Students of this module are able to design and optimally dimension a possible energy storage system for a specific task.
The basics for simulating and modeling energy storage systems are known.

syllabus_topics: Physical principles of selected storage technologies
Battery energy storage in stationary applications
Classification of storage according to power and energy storage
Optimal design and dimensioning of storage systems
Fuel cell systems, structure and classification of selected technologies
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination, which includes a preliminary assessment.
